components.note: 勹 (wrap) — a person curled around something; in 包 it wraps around a baby 巳, the original picture. 包 sounds out 抱 bào, 跑 pǎo, 泡 pào, 饱 bǎo.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 抱; 括 is to bundle together or enclose.
舌 here is a sound part rather than a tongue, shared by 活 huó, 话 huà and 阔 kuò: a loose hint.
氵 (water radical, 三点水) — water and liquids: 河, 汤, 洗; 汽 is steam, water turned to vapor.
气 (qì) is the same sound, and means vapor too.
车 (cart) — simplified from 車, a wheeled cart seen from above. As a radical it marks vehicles: 转 turn, 轮 wheel, 较.
刂 (knife) — cutting and sharpness: 利, 别, 到; 刻 is to carve, and the carved marks on a clock became quarter hours.
亥 (hài) is only a loose sound hint; same part in 孩 hái and 核 hé.
广 (a roof on a wall) — buildings and rooms: 店 shop, 床 bed, 库 store, 度. Here also the simplified form of 廣, broad.
⺮ (bamboo, 竹字头) — bamboo and written things: 笔, 第, 筷; 笨 first named a bamboo layer, then clumsy.
本 (běn) is a near sound match for bèn.
平 (píng, flat) also lends its sound to 评 píng, 苹 píng and 坪 píng.
史 (history) — a hand 又 holding a record, the scribe. 史 sounds the same as 使 shǐ and 驶 shǐ.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 俱 is people being together.
具 (jù) sounds exactly like 俱; also 惧 jù.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 拉, 抱; 拯 is to lift someone out of danger.
丞 (chéng) is a loose sound clue for zhěng (same -eng ending).
攵 (tap, hand with stick) — actions taken on something: 教, 放, 改; 救 is to take action to rescue.
求 (qiú) is a near sound match for jiù; 求 also means ask for help.
口 (mouth) — drinking and speaking: 喝, 吃, 啡; 啤 is part of the borrowed word for beer.
卑 (bēi) is a loose sound hint; also in 脾 pí, 牌 pái, 碑 bēi.
王 (jade, 玉 with its dot dropped) — jewels and polished things: 玩, 现, 理, 玻; 球 first meant a round gem.
求 (qiú) sounds exactly like 球.
心 (heart) — mind and feelings: 想, 思, 感; 愚 is a dull mind.
禺 (yú) sounds exactly like 愚; also in 遇 yù, 寓 yù.
虫 (insect) — insects and small creatures: 蚊, 蛇, 蜜; 蠢 is wriggling insects, then stupid.
春 (chūn) is a near sound match for chǔn.
阝 (city, right-side form of 邑) — towns and places: 都, 部, 那, 邮; 邦 is a state or country.
丰 (fēng) is a loose clue; 邦 itself gives bāng to 帮 bāng and 绑 bǎng.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — speech and talk: 说, 论, 请; 评 is to comment and judge.
平 (píng) sounds exactly like 评; also in 苹 píng.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter: 家, 安, 室; a guest is a person under your roof.
各 (gè) is a loose sound clue; same part in 路 lù, 洛 luò, 落 luò.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads: 过, 进, 送; 造 is to go and make something.
告 (gào) is a loose sound clue (-ao); also in 浩 hào, 靠 kào.
周 (zhōu) also lends its sound to 调 diào/tiáo, 稠 chóu, 绸 chóu and 凋 diāo.
木 (tree) — a stroke added at the top of a tree marks its tip: the end. Compare 未 wèi with the longer lower stroke.
⻊ (foot, form of 足) — feet and walking: 跑, 路, 跳; 跟 first meant the heel, then to follow.
艮 (gèn) is a near sound match for gēn; same part in 根 gēn, 很 hěn, 恨 hèn.
口 (mouth) — drinking and speaking: 吃, 吸, 呼; 喝 is to drink.
曷 (hé) sounds exactly like 喝; also in 渴 kě thirsty and 歇 xiē.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — metals and tools: 钱, 钢, 铁; 键 is a metal bar or key.
建 (jiàn) sounds exactly like 键; also in 健 jiàn.
氵 (water radical, 三点水) — water and liquids: 河, 海, 汤; 满 is filled with water, full.
The right half is a short form of 㒼 (mǎn), the sound part, also in 瞒 mán.
音 (sound) — a piece of music 音 played to its end by a person 儿: finishing, then "at last" or unexpectedly.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings and mind: 怕, 情, 快; 惯 is what the heart has grown used to.
贯 (guàn) sounds exactly like 惯.
王 (jade, 玉 with its dot dropped) — a blade 刂 cutting two jades apart: to divide into groups, hence class or shift.
走 (walk, run) — movement: 起, 超, 趣, 赶; 越 is to cross over, to exceed.
戉 (yuè) sounds exactly like 越.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings and mind: 怕, 情, 快; 恢 is broad-hearted, then restore.
灰 (huī) sounds exactly like 恢.
复 (fù) sounds out 腹 fù belly and 覆 fù cover; as a word it means again or to repeat, as in 恢复, 重复.
取 (qǔ, take) is a loose sound clue for jù; the part below shows people gathered together.
子 (child) — children: 孩, 学, 孙; 孕 puts a child inside: pregnant.
囗 (enclosure) — boundaries: 国 country, 回 return, 图 map; 园 is a fenced garden.
元 (yuán) sounds exactly like 园; also in 远 yuǎn, 院 yuàn, 完 wán.
纟 (thread, simplified 糸) — cord and silk: 红, 线, 给; 绑 is to bind with cord.
邦 (bāng) is a near sound match for bǎng.
木 (wood) — wooden things: 桌, 板, 桥; 架 is a wooden frame or rack.
加 (jiā) is a near sound match for jià; also in 驾 jià and 嘉 jiā.
艹 (grass, plants) — plants and leaves: 花, 草, 叶; 落 is leaves falling.
洛 (luò) sounds exactly like 落; related to 各 gè in 路 lù.
贝 (cowry shell, money) — wealth and trade: 财, 费, 买; 资 is capital or resources.
次 (cì) is a loose clue; same part in 姿 zī and 咨 zī.
斗 (dipper, measure) — measuring grain and liquids: 科, 斜, 升; 料 is rice 米 measured out, then material.
冫 (two dots) — simplified 净 uses these where traditional 淨 had 氵 water: clean by water. 争 (zhēng) is a loose sound clue; 静 jìng shares it.
女 (woman) — women and family: 妈, 妹, 婚, 姑; 姻 is a bond of marriage.
因 (yīn) sounds exactly like 姻; also in 烟 yān and 恩 ēn.
攵 (tap, hand with stick) — actions applied to people: 放, 改, 政; 教 is to teach, traditionally with a rod.
孝 (xiào) is a near sound match for jiào; also in 酵 jiào.
土 (earth) — ground and building sites: 地, 场, 块; 堂 is a raised hall.
尚 (shàng) gives the -ang sound; same part in 常 cháng, 掌 zhǎng, 堂 táng.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 健 is a strong body.
建 (jiàn) sounds exactly like 健; also in 键 jiàn.
户 (door, household) — one half of a double door 門. As a radical it marks doors and rooms: 房 room, 所 place, 扇 fan.
衣 (clothing, cloth) — clothes and cloth: 装, 被, 衬; 袋 is a bag made of cloth.
代 (dài) sounds exactly like 袋; also in 贷 dài.
